sentences.text: L'avocat de l'accusé prétend que son client a dû feindre la surprise devant la police.
sentences.en: The defendant's lawyer claims his client had to fake surprise in front of the police.
sentences.ko: 피고인의 변호사는 의뢰인이 경찰 앞에서 놀란 척해야 했다고 주장해요.

sentences.text: Le petit frère de Manon aime feindre d'être malade pour éviter les légumes.
sentences.en: Manon's little brother likes to pretend to be ill to avoid vegetables.
sentences.ko: 마농의 남동생은 채소를 안 먹으려고 아픈 척하는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Julien fait partie des six citoyens qu'on vient de sélectionner pour le jury.
sentences.en: Julien is one of the six citizens just selected for the jury.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 이번에 배심원으로 뽑힌 시민 여섯 명 중 한 명이에요.

sentences.text: Sur la tablette, Manon peut sélectionner ses plats et les envoyer en cuisine.
sentences.en: On the tablet, Manon can select her dishes and send them to the kitchen.
sentences.ko: 마농은 태블릿으로 음식을 골라 주방에 보낼 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Dans la salle d'audience, un silence lourd semble planer sur le public.
sentences.en: In the courtroom, a heavy silence seems to hang over the public.
sentences.ko: 법정에는 무거운 침묵이 방청객 위에 감도는 것 같아요.

sentences.text: Une bonne odeur de pain grillé semble planer dans toute la salle, et Manon a faim.
sentences.en: A nice smell of toasted bread seems to hang over the whole room, and Manon is hungry.
sentences.ko: 구운 빵 냄새가 식당 안에 퍼져 있어서 마농은 배가 고파요.

sentences.text: Selon le procureur, l'accusé aurait négligé de déclarer une partie de ses revenus.
sentences.en: According to the prosecutor, the defendant allegedly failed to declare part of his income.
sentences.ko: 검사에 따르면 피고인은 소득 일부를 신고하지 않았대요.

sentences.text: Manon ne veut pas négliger les clients de la terrasse pendant le coup de feu.
sentences.en: Manon doesn't want to neglect the customers on the terrace during the rush.
sentences.ko: 마농은 바쁜 시간에도 테라스 손님을 소홀히 하고 싶지 않아요.

sentences.text: Julien trouve futile la dispute des avocats sur l'heure exacte de l'appel.
sentences.en: Julien finds the lawyers' argument over the exact time of the call pointless.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 전화 시각을 두고 변호사들이 다투는 게 쓸데없다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Pour Manon, se disputer sur la couleur des serviettes est vraiment futile.
sentences.en: For Manon, arguing about the colour of the napkins is really pointless.
sentences.ko: 마농에게 냅킨 색깔로 다투는 건 정말 쓸데없는 일이에요.

sentences.text: L'issue du procès reste incertaine, et Julien prend beaucoup de notes.
sentences.en: The outcome of the trial remains uncertain, and Julien takes a lot of notes.
sentences.ko: 재판 결과가 아직 불확실해서 쥘리앵은 메모를 많이 해요.

sentences.text: Le temps est incertain, alors Manon hésite à installer les tables dehors.
sentences.en: The weather is uncertain, so Manon hesitates to set the tables outside.
sentences.ko: 날씨가 애매해서 마농은 밖에 테이블을 놓을지 망설여요.

sentences.text: Le témoin finit par consentir à répondre aux questions de Julien.
sentences.en: The witness finally agrees to answer Julien's questions.
sentences.ko: 증인은 결국 쥘리앵의 질문에 답하기로 해요.

sentences.text: Le chef a fini par consentir à mettre la recette de la grand-mère de Manon au menu.
sentences.en: The chef finally agreed to put Manon's grandmother's recipe on the menu.
sentences.ko: 주방장은 결국 마농 할머니의 요리법을 메뉴에 넣기로 했어요.

sentences.text: Le médecin confirme que l'accusé est apte à être jugé.
sentences.en: The doctor confirms that the defendant is fit to stand trial.
sentences.ko: 의사는 피고인이 재판을 받을 수 있는 상태라고 확인해요.

sentences.text: Après son entorse, le serveur n'est pas encore apte à porter des plateaux, alors Manon le remplace.
sentences.en: After his sprain, the waiter isn't fit to carry trays yet, so Manon fills in.
sentences.ko: 종업원이 발목을 삐어 아직 쟁반을 못 들어서 마농이 대신해요.

sentences.text: La juge demande de rejouer l'enregistrement de la caméra du parking.
sentences.en: The judge asks to replay the recording from the car-park camera.
sentences.ko: 판사가 주차장 카메라 영상을 다시 틀어 달라고 해요.

sentences.text: Les enfants veulent rejouer à la bataille de cartes en attendant les desserts de Manon.
sentences.en: The children want to play the card game again while waiting for Manon's desserts.
sentences.ko: 아이들은 마농의 디저트를 기다리며 카드놀이를 또 하고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Julien apprécie la clarté avec laquelle la juge explique la loi au jury.
sentences.en: Julien appreciates how clearly the judge explains the law to the jury.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 판사가 배심원에게 법을 분명하게 설명해 주는 게 좋아요.

sentences.text: Manon aime la clarté du nouveau menu, avec peu de plats et des prix lisibles.
sentences.en: Manon likes the clarity of the new menu, with few dishes and easy-to-read prices.
sentences.ko: 마농은 요리 수가 적고 가격이 잘 보이는 새 메뉴가 깔끔해서 좋아요.

sentences.text: Un greffier aurait égaré une pièce du dossier, ce qui retarde Julien et les autres jurés.
sentences.en: A clerk apparently mislaid a document from the file, which holds up Julien and the other jurors.
sentences.ko: 서기가 서류 하나를 잃어버렸다고 해서 쥘리앵과 다른 배심원들이 기다려요.

sentences.text: Un client a égaré ses lunettes, et Manon les retrouve sous la banquette.
sentences.en: A customer has mislaid his glasses, and Manon finds them under the bench seat.
sentences.ko: 손님이 안경을 잃어버렸는데 마농이 긴 의자 밑에서 찾아요.

sentences.text: L'avocate aligne les photos sur la table devant Julien et les jurés.
sentences.en: The lawyer lines up the photos on the table in front of Julien and the jurors.
sentences.ko: 변호사가 쥘리앵과 배심원들 앞 탁자에 사진을 나란히 놓아요.

sentences.text: Avant l'ouverture, Manon aligne les verres sur le comptoir.
sentences.en: Before opening, Manon lines up the glasses on the counter.
sentences.ko: 문을 열기 전에 마농은 계산대에 잔을 줄 맞춰 놓아요.

sentences.text: Le journaliste assis près de Julien a réussi à dégoter une place au premier rang.
sentences.en: The journalist sitting next to Julien managed to snag a seat in the front row.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵 옆의 기자는 용케 맨 앞줄 자리를 구했어요.

sentences.text: Manon a réussi à dégoter une vieille machine à glaces dans une brocante.
sentences.en: Manon managed to dig up an old ice-cream machine at a flea market.
sentences.ko: 마농은 벼룩시장에서 오래된 아이스크림 기계를 용케 구했어요.

sentences.text: L'accusé affirme qu'il ne voulait pas déshonorer sa famille.
sentences.en: The defendant says he didn't want to bring shame on his family.
sentences.ko: 피고인은 가족에게 수치를 주고 싶지 않았다고 말해요.

sentences.text: Le grand-père de Manon dit qu'une mauvaise sauce pourrait déshonorer la maison.
sentences.en: Manon's grandfather says a bad sauce could disgrace the house.
sentences.ko: 마농의 할아버지는 소스가 맛없으면 가게 이름에 먹칠을 한다고 해요.

sentences.text: Julien se souvient d'un documentaire sur les atrocités jugées par un tribunal international.
sentences.en: Julien remembers a documentary about atrocities tried by an international court.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 국제 재판소가 다룬 잔학 행위에 관한 다큐멘터리를 떠올려요.

sentences.text: En plaisantant, Manon traite d'atrocité la pizza à l'ananas de son frère.
sentences.en: Jokingly, Manon calls her brother's pineapple pizza an atrocity.
sentences.ko: 마농은 동생의 파인애플 피자를 끔찍한 만행이라며 농담해요.

sentences.text: Pour l'avocat, cette lettre n'est qu'une échappatoire pour éviter la prison.
sentences.en: For the lawyer, this letter is just a way out to avoid prison.
sentences.ko: 변호사가 보기에 이 편지는 감옥을 피하려는 핑계일 뿐이에요.

sentences.text: Manon ne laisse aucune échappatoire à son frère : il doit finir sa soupe.
sentences.en: Manon leaves her brother no way out: he has to finish his soup.
sentences.ko: 마농은 동생에게 빠져나갈 구멍을 주지 않아요. 수프를 다 먹어야 해요.

sentences.text: Julien découvre que le prétendu cambriolage était en fait un canular d'étudiants.
sentences.en: Julien discovers that the supposed burglary was in fact a student prank.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 강도 사건이라던 게 사실 학생들의 장난이었다는 걸 알게 돼요.

sentences.text: La fausse réservation pour cinquante personnes n'était qu'un canular, soupire Manon.
sentences.en: The fake booking for fifty people was just a hoax, Manon sighs.
sentences.ko: 오십 명 가짜 예약은 장난이었다며 마농이 한숨을 쉬어요.

sentences.text: Un militant écologiste comparaît pour avoir bloqué une route avec Julien dans le public.
sentences.en: An environmental activist appears in court for blocking a road, with Julien in the audience.
sentences.ko: 도로를 막은 혐의로 환경 운동가가 법정에 서고, 쥘리앵은 방청석에 있어요.

sentences.text: Un militant associatif vient chaque mois dîner chez Manon avec ses bénévoles.
sentences.en: A community activist comes to dinner at Manon's every month with his volunteers.
sentences.ko: 한 시민 단체 활동가가 매달 자원봉사자들과 마농의 식당에서 저녁을 먹어요.

sentences.text: Le procureur absent est remplacé par son substitut, une jeune femme que Julien connaît.
sentences.en: The absent prosecutor is replaced by his deputy, a young woman Julien knows.
sentences.ko: 검사가 빠져서 쥘리앵이 아는 젊은 여성 대리 검사가 대신 나와요.

sentences.text: Manon utilise un substitut de sucre pour les desserts de certains clients.
sentences.en: Manon uses a sugar substitute for some customers' desserts.
sentences.ko: 마농은 몇몇 손님 디저트에 설탕 대신 감미료를 써요.

sentences.text: Le procès est télévisé, et la mère de Julien le regarde depuis son salon.
sentences.en: The trial is televised, and Julien's mother watches it from her living room.
sentences.ko: 재판이 텔레비전으로 중계돼서 쥘리앵의 어머니가 거실에서 봐요.

sentences.text: Le restaurant de Manon est passé dans une émission télévisée sur la cuisine régionale.
sentences.en: Manon's restaurant appeared on a TV programme about regional cooking.
sentences.ko: 마농의 식당이 지역 요리를 다루는 텔레비전 프로그램에 나왔어요.

sentences.text: L'affaire porte sur une tromperie dans la vente d'une voiture d'occasion.
sentences.en: The case concerns deception in the sale of a used car.
sentences.ko: 이 사건은 중고차 판매 사기에 관한 거예요.

sentences.text: Manon refuse toute tromperie : le menu indique quand les frites sont surgelées.
sentences.en: Manon refuses any deception: the menu says when the fries are frozen.
sentences.ko: 마농은 속이는 걸 싫어해서 감자튀김이 냉동이면 메뉴에 적어요.

sentences.text: Pour Julien, un jury tiré au sort rend la justice plus démocratique.
sentences.en: For Julien, a jury drawn by lot makes justice more democratic.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 추첨으로 뽑은 배심원 덕분에 재판이 더 민주적이라고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Chez Manon, le choix du dessert se fait de façon démocratique, à main levée.
sentences.en: At Manon's, the dessert is chosen democratically, by a show of hands.
sentences.ko: 마농의 집에서는 디저트를 손을 들어 민주적으로 정해요.

sentences.text: Les jurés reçoivent une copie du décret qui fixe les règles du stationnement.
sentences.en: The jurors receive a copy of the decree setting the parking rules.
sentences.ko: 배심원들은 주차 규칙을 정한 법령 사본을 받아요.

sentences.text: Manon plaisante en disant que son père dirige la cuisine par décret.
sentences.en: Manon jokes that her father runs the kitchen by decree.
sentences.ko: 마농은 아빠가 주방을 명령으로 다스린다고 농담해요.

sentences.text: Devant le tribunal, un manifestant tient une pancarte que Julien lit en passant.
sentences.en: Outside the court, a protester holds a sign that Julien reads as he walks by.
sentences.ko: 법원 앞에서 한 시위자가 팻말을 들고 있고, 쥘리앵이 지나가며 읽어요.

sentences.text: Un manifestant fatigué entre chez Manon pour boire un chocolat chaud.
sentences.en: A tired protester comes into Manon's place for a hot chocolate.
sentences.ko: 지친 시위 참가자가 핫초코를 마시러 마농의 식당에 들어와요.

sentences.text: La juge rappelle que la légitime défense n'est pas la même chose que l'autodéfense organisée.
sentences.en: The judge reminds them that legal self-defence is not the same thing as organised vigilantism.
sentences.ko: 판사는 정당방위와 조직적인 자경 행위는 같지 않다고 짚어요.

sentences.text: Le frère de Manon prend des cours d'autodéfense le mercredi après l'école.
sentences.en: Manon's brother takes self-defence classes on Wednesdays after school.
sentences.ko: 마농의 동생은 수요일 방과 후에 호신술 수업을 들어요.

sentences.text: L'accusé parle de « petit malentendu », un euphémisme qui fait sourire Julien.
sentences.en: The defendant talks of a "little misunderstanding", a euphemism that makes Julien smile.
sentences.ko: 피고인이 "작은 오해"라고 하자 그 완곡한 말에 쥘리앵이 웃음을 참아요.

sentences.text: Le chef parle de « cuisson créative » : c'est un euphémisme pour la viande brûlée, rit Manon.
sentences.en: The chef talks about "creative cooking": it's a euphemism for burnt meat, Manon laughs.
sentences.ko: 주방장이 "창의적인 굽기"라고 하자 그건 탄 고기를 돌려 말한 거라며 마농이 웃어요.

sentences.text: Selon l'avocate, le policier a créé une entrave au travail des secours.
sentences.en: According to the lawyer, the police officer obstructed the work of the emergency services.
sentences.ko: 변호사는 그 경찰관이 구조대의 일을 방해했다고 말해요.

sentences.text: Les travaux devant la porte sont une vraie entrave pour les clients de Manon.
sentences.en: The roadworks outside the door are a real obstacle for Manon's customers.
sentences.ko: 문 앞 공사가 마농의 손님들에게 큰 걸림돌이에요.

sentences.text: Julien est surpris par l'abondance de preuves présentées dès le premier jour.
sentences.en: Julien is surprised by the wealth of evidence presented on the very first day.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 첫날부터 나온 증거가 너무 많아 놀라요.

sentences.text: Au marché, Manon profite de l'abondance de tomates en été.
sentences.en: At the market, Manon makes the most of the abundance of tomatoes in summer.
sentences.ko: 마농은 여름 시장에 토마토가 넘쳐날 때 실컷 사요.

sentences.text: Dans le dossier, Julien lit la revendication des locataires contre leur propriétaire.
sentences.en: In the file, Julien reads the tenants' claim against their landlord.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 서류에서 세입자들이 집주인에게 낸 요구를 읽어요.

sentences.text: Les serveurs ont une revendication simple : Manon doit acheter un lave-vaisselle.
sentences.en: The waiters have a simple demand: Manon must buy a dishwasher.
sentences.ko: 종업원들의 요구는 간단해요. 마농이 식기세척기를 사야 한대요.

sentences.text: Le juge suspend l'audience pour un ajustement technique du micro de Julien.
sentences.en: The judge adjourns the hearing for a technical adjustment to Julien's microphone.
sentences.ko: 판사가 쥘리앵의 마이크를 손보려고 재판을 잠시 멈춰요.

sentences.text: Après quelques ajustements, la nouvelle recette de Manon plaît à tout le monde.
sentences.en: After a few adjustments, Manon's new recipe pleases everyone.
sentences.ko: 몇 번 손본 뒤 마농의 새 요리법은 모두에게 인기예요.

sentences.text: Le témoin, un ancien pasteur protestant, parle d'une voix calme à Julien.
sentences.en: The witness, a former Protestant pastor, speaks to Julien in a calm voice.
sentences.ko: 개신교 목사였던 증인이 차분한 목소리로 쥘리앵에게 말해요.

sentences.text: Le restaurant de Manon se trouve à côté d'un temple protestant.
sentences.en: Manon's restaurant is next to a Protestant church.
sentences.ko: 마농의 식당은 개신교 교회 옆에 있어요.

sentences.text: Julien a vu un reportage sur un groupe extrémiste dont les membres ont été condamnés.
sentences.en: Julien saw a report about an extremist group whose members were convicted.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 극단주의 단체 회원들이 유죄 판결을 받은 보도를 본 적이 있어요.

sentences.text: Le frère de Manon est un extrémiste du ketchup : il en met partout.
sentences.en: Manon's brother is a ketchup extremist: he puts it on everything.
sentences.ko: 마농의 동생은 케첩 광이라서 어디에나 뿌려요.

sentences.text: La juge, qui pratique la méditation bouddhiste, garde toujours son calme face à Julien.
sentences.en: The judge, who practises Buddhist meditation, always stays calm in front of Julien.
sentences.ko: 불교 명상을 하는 판사는 쥘리앵 앞에서 늘 침착해요.

sentences.text: Une famille bouddhiste demande à Manon des plats sans viande.
sentences.en: A Buddhist family asks Manon for meat-free dishes.
sentences.ko: 불교 신자 가족이 마농에게 고기 없는 요리를 부탁해요.

sentences.text: Julien remarque que les avocats forment deux factions qui ne se parlent pas.
sentences.en: Julien notices that the lawyers form two factions that don't speak to each other.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 변호사들이 서로 말도 안 하는 두 파로 갈린 걸 알아채요.

sentences.text: Autour de la table, Manon voit deux factions se former : pizza ou crêpes.
sentences.en: Around the table, Manon sees two factions forming: pizza or crêpes.
sentences.ko: 식탁에서 피자파와 크레프파 두 파가 생기는 걸 마농이 봐요.

sentences.text: L'avocat de la défense trouve le comportement de son client immature mais pas criminel.
sentences.en: The defence lawyer finds his client's behaviour immature but not criminal.
sentences.ko: 변호인은 의뢰인의 행동이 철없긴 해도 범죄는 아니라고 봐요.

sentences.text: Le cousin de Manon fait des blagues immatures avec les pailles.
sentences.en: Manon's cousin makes childish jokes with the straws.
sentences.ko: 마농의 사촌은 빨대로 유치한 장난을 쳐요.

sentences.text: Le témoin porte un costume démodé que Julien trouve plutôt élégant.
sentences.en: The witness wears an old-fashioned suit that Julien finds rather elegant.
sentences.ko: 증인은 유행이 지난 양복을 입었는데 쥘리앵은 꽤 멋있다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Manon trouve la déco du restaurant un peu démodée, mais les clients l'adorent.
sentences.en: Manon finds the restaurant's decor a bit dated, but the customers love it.
sentences.ko: 마농은 식당 장식이 좀 촌스럽다고 생각하지만 손님들은 아주 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Julien boit son café dans un gobelet jetable pendant la pause.
sentences.en: Julien drinks his coffee from a disposable cup during the break.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 휴정 시간에 일회용 컵으로 커피를 마셔요.

sentences.text: Le restaurant de Manon a remplacé les couverts jetables par de vrais couverts.
sentences.en: Manon's restaurant has replaced disposable cutlery with real cutlery.
sentences.ko: 마농의 식당은 일회용 수저를 진짜 수저로 바꿨어요.

sentences.text: L'accusé, un musicien, jure à Julien et aux jurés qu'il était en train de jouer du violoncelle ce soir-là.
sentences.en: The defendant, a musician, swears to Julien and the jurors that he was playing the cello that evening.
sentences.ko: 음악가인 피고인은 그날 밤 첼로를 연주하고 있었다고 쥘리앵과 배심원들에게 맹세해요.

sentences.text: Le soir, un étudiant joue du violoncelle pendant que Manon sert les plats.
sentences.en: In the evening, a student plays the cello while Manon serves the dishes.
sentences.ko: 저녁에 한 학생이 첼로를 연주하고 마농은 음식을 내요.

sentences.text: Le peintre appelé à témoigner présente sa femme comme sa muse, et Julien sourit.
sentences.en: The painter called to testify presents his wife as his muse, and Julien smiles.
sentences.ko: 증인으로 나온 화가가 아내를 자기 뮤즈라고 소개하자 쥘리앵이 웃어요.

sentences.text: Manon dit en riant que sa grand-mère est la muse de toute la cuisine.
sentences.en: Manon says with a laugh that her grandmother is the muse of the whole kitchen.
sentences.ko: 마농은 할머니가 주방 전체의 뮤즈라고 웃으며 말해요.

sentences.text: Une interprète traduit pour un témoin iranien, et Julien écoute attentivement.
sentences.en: An interpreter translates for an Iranian witness, and Julien listens carefully.
sentences.ko: 통역사가 이란인 증인의 말을 통역하고, 쥘리앵은 귀 기울여 들어요.

sentences.text: Une cliente donne à Manon la recette d'un riz iranien au safran.
sentences.en: A customer gives Manon the recipe for a Persian-style saffron rice.
sentences.ko: 한 손님이 마농에게 이란식 사프란 밥 요리법을 알려 줘요.
